title: Raise the coding-reference reply cap so coding answers are not cut off (owner decision 2026-11-26)
goal: The coding cases' replies can finish inside the 180 s case: the coding-reference packs get a larger output-token budget than the profile's 2,048, the other packs keep theirs
acceptance: The owner's decision is recorded in F-120 with its date and words

Packs on the coding-reference runner raise the profile's reply cap and the suite budget (3,072 tokens a case, chosen to fit the 180 s case), every other pack keeps the profile and limits, with a regression test (failing first)
The four coding cases rerun on gemma4:12b without --allow-expensive and recorded in the ledger and F-120; if still cut off at the new cap, that is recorded and the cap is not raised again
privacy: Code, tests and neutral Gauntlet evidence only; no secrets or personal data.
validation: node --test test/gauntlet.test.mjs (F-120-T07 fails without the change)
escalation: A further raise of the cap is the owner's call

effort.basis: Opened and done 2026-11-26 from the nerv#800 coding failures (owner: "Raise the output limit for the coding packs ok"): cap by pack, failing-first test, docs and one coding rerun.
